bio.text: Katie Stewart, a Democrat, represents District 59 in the Colorado House of Representatives, covering Archuleta, La Plata, Montezuma and San Juan counties.
She has held the seat since January 2025 and is a candidate in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Before that she held the District D seat on the Durango School District 9-R board, leaving it in 2025.
She was born in San Francisco, graduated from Bellevue East High School, attended the Brooks Institute of Photography and has worked in advocacy.
